releases.summary: The code Plugin's first Release: served at /code/<sha256>/rpc, its records at their first version
Worktrees: a Session runs in a Worktree on a branch; branches lists them; startSession streams its Starting steps and leaves nothing when it fails; Session records at v2
Images a tool gives back come through whole
Kabuki's new namespaces: no change in what it does
Kabuki's explicit doors: no change in what it does
Kabuki's trimmed doors: no change in what it does
The code Plugin on Kabuki's Emits, Children made with child, and partial Models; its build changed only by the move to them.
The code Plugin on Kabuki's definitions that build, Children made with Actor.child, and declared Queries; the Session's Queries now declare their args and answers.
Background work is kept as it comes, a cancel stops every job, and a restart tells the agent what it cut off
A tool result says when its call went on in the background, so an async subagent reads as running
Codex usage counts its input as Claude Code's does, apart from what the cache read and wrote
A Background Job's output can be followed live (backgroundJobOutput); a subagent job says its tokens so far, which a Session's record does not keep
A Project inside a git repository, as a package of a monorepo, is a git Project: it lists the branches, and its Sessions run in the same folder of each Worktree
A Session Resumed on start is active from after its cut-off Turn ended

A Take is heard as its audio comes in, and survives a reconnect: watchTake, addTakeAudio and endTake, with TakeHeard Downloading, Heard or Done; a Take watched is never dropped, and one dropped or broken fails its watchers
A new folder is only a folder: createFolder starts no git repository, and CreatedFolder has no gitInitError
Moves to Kabuki's new Runtime and Blueprint API
